Teams and email messages stay consistent and match your organization's voice, which helps more employees see the survey and take part.

items.description: The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
items.description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
items.description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.
A new View-Only Device Man

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Organize and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
items.description: Users can organize and merge PDF files in the Microsoft Edge built-in PDF reader. They can select pages to extract, delete, rotate, or reorder, and save the result as a new PDF file. They can also merge the open PDF file with other PDF files that are open in Microsoft Edge tabs or stored on their device, to create a single PDF file. Files are processed on the device, and the original files aren't modified. Admins can manage this feature using the PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
items.description:
Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort.
Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, descr

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
items.description:
Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high‑level capabilities.
Intraday queue tracking

Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time.
Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand.
Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand.
Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations.
Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling bre

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
items.description:
Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.
The experience highlights agreement, differences, and overall grading behavior.
Core capabilities
The core capabilities include:

Compare graders side-by-side.
Compare scores.
Review explanations from each grader.
Analyze grading consistency.

Results experience
Results include:

Comparative score view.
Pass / fail comparison.
Grader explanations.
Evidence supporting each evaluation.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Simplify the creation of recurring expenses
items.description: This feature enables employees to automatically generate expense entries for predictable, repeatable business expenses (for example, monthly mobile bills, internet charges, parking, and subscriptions) without manual re-entry each period. It reduces repetitive effort, improves compliance, and ensures timely and accurate expense submission, while respecting organizational expense policies and approval workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
items.description: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

items.title: Outlook: Teams Meeting Options
items.description: When you add a Teams meeting to an event in Outlook for Mac, the join link and dial-in details now appear in the invite while you're still writing it. A new Meeting Options button lets you change the Teams meeting settings right away, before you send.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
items.description:
Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration.
Choose the Business Central companies and tables to synchronise, and make the data available in OneLake for use with Fabric IQ, Power BI, Data Factory, and other analytics experiences.
Get started quickly with ready-made sample Power BI apps, while built-in logging provides visibility into synchronisation health and helps troubleshoot issues.

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
items.description: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microso

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic

items.title: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
items.description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
items.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
items.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS. Updated October 20, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
items.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
items.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description:
Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.
#copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Enhanced Rollout Waves
items.description: New improvements are coming to the rollout wave functionality for Cloud Update. These enhancements will allow organizations to continue leveraging Microsoft Entra ID groups to set up rollout waves, with increased flexibility to configure more than the current limit of three waves. Additionally, admins will be able to assign custom delays between each wave, streamlining phased deployments and offering greater control over update distribution.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
items.description: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Backup Activity Logs
items.description: In product monitoring logs to track all activities related to backup policy configuration & restore related tasks. This will help admins with troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing capabilities.
